messages:
maya: RFC follow-up: propose a 'probe-sanity' stage in onboarding to catch KV-cache/ABI mismatches and obvious perf regressions before full bench.

maya: Flow: ingest + normalized fingerprint -> probe-sanity (small e2e sample) -> kv-schema check -> decision: auto-onboard / canary / reject.

cheng: Need concrete cost/time targets.

maya: Target ~100-300 samples, single shard, <2m wall time, cost << full bench.

aj: Fingerprint idea: normalized JSON of {arch,dtype,shapes,ops,tokenizer} -> sha256. Fast diff.

kai: Also emit kv-schema (keylen, header-layout, seq-tolerance). If checksum differs, surface failure.

maya: PASS criteria (initial proposal): p95 < 200ms or within 1.5x baseline; gpu_mem < 60%; kv_ok=true; semantic-sim delta <0.15.

aj: Persist probe artifacts (fingerprint, kv-schema, logs, 5 probe prompts) in registry with 30d TTL.

kai: If fingerprint mismatches but probe PASSes, create a canary variant (10% traffic) and kick off full bench async. Avoid blocking product teams.

ci-bot: Minor harness change needed to emit kv-schema; will open PR.

cheng: UX: console should show probe artifacts and an 'accept canary' action for owners.

maya: I'll update RFC with thresholds, runbook for FAILs, and a short owner checklist. Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow to finalize gating matrix.

aj: :thumbsup:

kai: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks, will post RFC link here when updated.
